text:
We can confirm that Prof. Ansel Okafor led the excavation at Tel Maridun, directing the spring field season for the Maridun Survey Unit. Work ran from 14 March to 2 May, with a crew of 18, including ceramic analyst Liora Venn and survey engineer Tomas Hald. The trenching plan focused on the north terrace, where we logged a stepped mudbrick wall, three ash lenses, and a sealed storage pit. We also recovered 214 catalogued finds, most of them coarse ware sherds and copper offcuts.

- Lead excavator: Prof. Ansel Okafor
- Site: Tel Maridun
- Field season: 14 March–2 May
- Crew size: 18
- Logged finds: 214 catalogued items
